name: TicToon
original_description: TicToon lets you publish comics made in ChatGPT to the TicToon channels you have joined. List your channels, upload images you created or attached in ChatGPT (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 per post), and publish them as a new comic thread with a caption. Every action runs with the permissions you granted when connecting, and you can only post in channels you already joined. You can disconnect at any time from Connected apps on tictoon.app.
